categories.description: The legacy extractor took the wrong block, mangled or truncated text, kept exposition or per-stage output, or needed manual extraction.
categories.name: EXTRACTION
categories.resolution: Retire when the pinned scenario extractor produces an equivalent scenario natively.

categories.description: Shell source the legacy JSON parser could not read: helper constructors, inline variables, arithmetic, timestamps, index text, broken punctuation.
categories.name: SHELL_SYNTAX
categories.resolution: Retire when shell normalization lowers the source to the same typed BSON.

categories.description: Morphia generates an equivalent but differently shaped or ordered command: short $cond/$eq forms, field order, _id placement, argument layout.
categories.name: MORPHIA_FORM
categories.resolution: Replace with a declared, reviewed command-equivalence rule or Morphia compatibility decision.

categories.description: Numeric values changed type or precision to match Java/BSON typing or server results.
categories.name: NUMERIC_TYPE
categories.resolution: Retire when typed BSON comparison proves the documented values; otherwise keep as a typed override.

categories.description: The upstream documentation's data or results are wrong or inconsistent.
categories.name: DOCS_ERROR
categories.resolution: Keep as a reviewed correction pinned to the source digest; re-check when upstream changes.

categories.description: Test data or expectations adjusted so the example is executable and deterministic: renamed collections, added or filtered data, predictable ids, prior-example state.
categories.name: FIXTURE_CURATION
categories.resolution: Keep as an explicit setup or expectation override in the scenario manifest.

categories.description: The example cannot run in this harness (for example a change-stream watch loop).
categories.name: UNTESTABLE
categories.resolution: Keep as a scoped exemption with reevaluation criteria.
